seo.title: ODDspace — workspace, studios and event space in Vallila
seo.description: ODDspace is a workspace, event space and recording/production studio in Vallila, Helsinki — for working, meeting, exhibitions, talks, events and creative projects.

intro: Come here to work. Meet people. Host events. Or simply have a place to return to between projects.

whatItIs.headline: Workspace, studios, events and community under one roof.
whatItIs.body:
ODDspace is a year-round workspace and event space in Vallila for people working across art, culture, design, media, technology, business and other creative fields. It includes coworking areas, meeting rooms, an event and gallery floor, an auditorium and ODDstudio.

People can work independently, host events and cross paths with others from very different fields. ODDspace is still evolving, and the people who use it help shape what it becomes.

vision.headline: Creative work needs more than moments.
vision.body:
Great things happen in projects, events, commissions and productions. But when they end, people disperse, momentum fades and the next thing often starts from scratch.

ODDspace exists to give creative work a place to continue between those moments — somewhere to return to, keep working, meet people outside your own field and develop ideas before they have a brief, budget or stage.

The ambition is bigger than providing desks or rooms. We want to create a place where work, relationships and opportunities can grow over time. ODDspace is the first working version of that idea.

faq.question: Is the studio included in the membership?
faq.answer: No. ODDstudio is the one space that isn't covered by the €150 / month membership. Members can add full studio access for €100 / month — €250 / month in total, including the ODDspace membership — or book the studio at €20 / hour. Booking the studio by the hour does not require a membership. Full rates, equipment and booking terms are on the ODDstudio page.

faq.question: What is ODDspace?
faq.answer: A workspace and event space in Vallila, Helsinki with coworking areas, meeting rooms, an event and gallery floor, an auditorium and ODDstudio, a creative music studio. People can work independently while the space also makes it easier to share work, ask for input and collaborate when it makes sense.

faq.question: Do I need an ODDspace membership to take part?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Day-to-day workspace access is a membership product, but ODDspace also hosts events, projects and collaborations involving people who are not members.

faq.question: How do I become a member?
faq.answer: Pick a time to see the space on the membership page, or ask for a free trial day there. The same page has the price, what's included and how joining works. Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis while space is available.

faq.question: What does membership cost?
faq.answer: €150 per month, one flat rate — no tiers.

faq.question: What's included in membership?
faq.answer: Full, 24/7 access to the co-working space, shared facilities and meeting rooms, plus member rates on bookable event spaces.

faq.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No — it's a flexible monthly membership with no long-term commitment during the pilot phase.

faq.question: Can I visit before joining?
faq.answer: Yes. Pick two or three times on the membership page, or come to Coffee on the House on a Monday at 09:00, and someone from the team will show you round.

faq.question: Can non-members organise events?
faq.answer: Yes. Renting the gallery or auditorium doesn't require membership — get a quote on the venue page with what you have in mind.

faq.question: What kinds of events can happen there?
faq.answer: Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots, gatherings, performances and showcases have all happened in the space.

faq.question: What spaces are available?
faq.answer: Co-working space, an event/gallery floor, an auditorium and ODDstudio, a creative music studio.

faq.question: How much does event use cost?
faq.answer: From €300 + VAT for creative organisations and cultural workers, and from €750 + VAT for companies. For your own event, get a quote on the venue page — tell us the date and what you're planning, and we reply with availability and a price within one working day.

faq.question: How do I enquire about an event?
faq.answer: Get a quote on the venue page. You don't need to be a member first.

faq.question: Is ODDspace accessible?
faq.answer: We are still verifying the building's accessibility details. If accessibility affects your visit, email hello@oddfest.co before coming and we will confirm the current route, lifts and toilets.
